name: What factors should I consider when choosing a door frame material?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a door frame material?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a door frame material, consider the door's location (interior vs. exterior), required durability, security needs, and aesthetic preferences. For exterior doors, prioritize weather resistance and insulation, making fiberglass or steel good options. For interior doors, wood offers versatility and warmth. Maintenance requirements are also important; some materials need more regular painting or sealing than others. Finally, ensure the material complements your home's existing architecture and design in your South San Francisco or San Bruno home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a door frame material based on location, durability, security needs, aesthetics, and maintenance requirements to complement your home.
